title: Bear meat

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Bear meat is a basic food source. It can be found by killing Bears and Viles.
When placed on a Cooking station or Iron cooking station, Bear meat can be turned into Cooked bear meat, or Coal if overcooked. Unlike other meats, it is not used in any Cauldron recipes.

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text:
• Cooked bear meat
• Coal, if left on a Cooking station for too long
